verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.

verses.text: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not swerved from thy testimonies.

verses.text: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.
